summary: Accenture plc filed an 8-K reporting entry into two new senior unsecured revolving credit facilities totaling $8.1 billion ($5.925B five-year and $2.175B 364-day) replacing a prior $5.5B facility. The credit agreements are for general corporate purposes and commercial paper backstop, with interest based on SOFR plus a ratings-based margin. This is a routine refinancing of committed credit lines, not a special situation. The filing contains standard covenant terms and no special event.
